about: Source-grounded synthetic challenge cases for the ACFTA check. Expected labels were derived by oracle.py from the cited primary rule rows and treaty clauses, not by running the candidate engine. Cases were authored by the implementer with knowledge of the engine interface; this is not blind authoring and not independent real-world customs rulings.
label_method: oracle.py over the cited rule rows; hand-specified rows are marked in the case rule field
